text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working machine learning engineer with 6 years of experience, and I’d love to help you develop a low-energy 4G IP camera solution that balances reliable performance with practical power usage.

Your project is especially interesting because it combines camera functionality, connectivity, and energy efficiency into one product. I understand the core requirements you outlined: normal camera features like remote streaming, IR, video, and recording; at least 12 hours of continuous working time; remote wake up or sleep; support for both 4G and WiFi; and a built-in battery. I’m comfortable working on the AI and software side of embedded and camera-related systems, and I can contribute to a flexible solution approach that fits the budget and sample development scope.

In previous work, I built product recommendation systems for Tidewater Outfitters using Python and PyTorch, where I trained similar-items and “you-may-also-like” carousels on 1.2M interactions and cached results in Redis. That work improved click-through rate by 14% in a 4-week A/B test. I also developed a camera-based ceramic tile defect detection system for Halvorsen Ceramics using Python, PyTorch, YOLOv8, OpenCV, and ONNX, which ran on an industrial PC beside the kiln line and achieved 97.4% recall on cracks while reducing false rejects from 8% to 2.1%.

While those projects were in different domains, they reflect the kind of hands-on problem solving needed for a camera product: working with visual data, building practical production-ready systems, and delivering solutions that perform reliably in real-world conditions. I also bring broad experience with Python, machine learning, NLP, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, and pandas.

If selected, I’d focus on helping define a realistic technical approach for the camera features, power constraints, and remote control behavior so the final product can be built efficiently and tested properly. I’d be glad to discuss flexible implementation options and how to align development effort with your budget.
